$comment: The source of sf-progress-bar's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/progress-bar (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs over simai/ui-source@5100227); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Every x-todo of the conversion is decided: x-decisions says how.

chunk.x-summary: Shows a part of a job (vocabulary §5.2 chunk {done, total}): value becomes done of total in per cent; total defaults to 100

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16).

accessibility.$comment: The root carries role progressbar with aria-valuemin 0, aria-valuemax 100, aria-valuenow the value and aria-valuetext the value-text when given; it takes no focus and no keys.

x-summary: Continuous determinate progress with normalized value, accessible range semantics and explicit semantic tone.

forbidden_client_responsibilities: running, cancelling or retrying the task
inferring success, warning or error from the numeric percentage

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-progress-bar for continuous determinate progress with a known value from 0 to 100.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component
Do not use Progress Bar for an unknown value; use Spinner
Do not omit a localized accessible label
Do not infer semantic tone from the percentage
Do not make the progress indicator focusable

x-renamed: settings.tone: the status axis's old name, a dated setting alias of status
settings.progress: an object read off setProgress by the conversion, not a setting; it leaves (the value is value, a job's part is the action chunk)
methods.setProgress → actions.chunk: a dated action alias; setProgress(n) is chunk(n), n of 100
methods.getProgress, setTextPosition: a reader and a setter of a writable setting retire (§4.4), kept and noted until the date
x-decisions: version: 1.0.0 → 1.1.0: tone and setProgress are dated aliases, value is a number, chunk is added; a minor while the aliases hold (§4.10).

setter: setProgress was a set-<name> method of the writable setting value (§4.4); a page writes value. A job's progress reaches the bar as the stream fact chunk {done, total} of vocabulary 1.1.5 §5.2, so the action a rule asks is chunk: a rule on <source>.chunk asks <bar>.chunk with the carried done and total. setProgress(n) is its dated alias (n of 100).
number-type: value holds a percentage, 0..100, clamped by the template; it is a number (§16 item 29) and an attribute that is no number reads 0.

a11y-role: progressbar on the root with aria-valuenow (the value), aria-valuemin 0, aria-valuemax 100 and aria-valuetext (value-text); the name is label, else the host's aria-label (§3.1, §4.8); no keys and no focus.
template: templates.default names the Lit template js/templates/default.js, the migration form §5.2 allows.
examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json and studio.scenario.json plus a status and a value text; probe.json drives value, chunk and the aliases.
skeleton: none; the bar has no port and no late data: its static markup is its first paint (§5.4).
css-variables: 6 public variables read by the class sheet with the role token as fallback (src/core/contracts/public-variables.v1.json).
settings: tone leaves for its dated alias row (status answers), and progress, an object the conversion read off setProgress, is no setting: value is the setting and chunk the action.

version 1.1.1: the bundle carries no element layer of its own -- element-manifest, aliases, the alias table, the host port, deprecations, page actions, the layer stack, the open-surface mark and the instance path come from the page's shared runtime (SF.runtimeModule, runtime ABI 1, core.runtime 1.1.0), one instance per page -- and embeds of this file only the keys the runtime reads. Behaviour unchanged.
